page.overview:
Who is Asdrúbal Bayardo?

Asdrúbal Fontes Bayardo (born 26 December 1922 and died 9 July 2006) was a Uruguayan racing driver. He raced in a variety of series including Argentine Formula Libre, in which was shown good success. In , he finished tenth in the non-championship 1958 Buenos Aries Grand Prix driving a private Maserati 250F. The following year, he ventured to Europe to race for Scuderia Centro Sud at the 1959 French Grand Prix, although he failed to set a time in qualifying.
